head: a1b3b371
headSubject: feat(dsl,generator,runtimehost): add panelDataSource.totalField + row-action clone/inputFields; close WMS-16 (Recebimento side)
summary: Committed WMS-15's confirmationText fix, then implemented and closed WMS-16's Recebimento-side item-level wizard end-to-end: a new scope=row procedure-bound Panel action (AdicionarItemRecebimentoProcedure) for Adicionar Itens, default-1-position, duplicate-product refusal via a new AllocationCapability.verificarProdutoDuplicado (throw-to-block precedent), a new reusable panelDataSource.totalField platform primitive threaded through all 4 schema mirrors/AST/compiler/canonical-JSON/validation/runtime/mustache, and a generator-only row-clone Clonar button. Also fixed a platform gap found along the way (row-scoped Panel actions never rendered inputFields mini-forms), a real DSL coverage-ratchet regression (added tests, re-pinned the floor honestly), and an invalid verification:PARTIAL ledger enum value on both WMS-15 and WMS-16.
nextStep: Pick up WMS-16's Expedicao residual next (see ledger/items/WMS-16.yml's RESIDUAL section): build the same 5 building blocks for ExpedicaoDemandaPanel/ExpedicaoItem that were just built for Recebimento -- a scope=row procedure-bound action mirroring AdicionarItemRecebimentoProcedure, an analogous duplicate-produto capability method (simpler than Recebimento's since ExpedicaoItem already carries produtoId directly, no Lote join needed), and reuse the SAME totalField/Clonar platform primitives unchanged (no new platform code needed for those two). Alternative: QUAL-41 (MEDIUM) is also still open. Neither an actual ScrapForAI browser pass over the Recebimento wizard UI nor WMS-15's missing test guard (flagged by check-done-item-guards.py, status:DONE with no guard: block) were done -- both are real residuals from this and the prior session, not started.
verified: Full :test task on the assembled wmsoffice-browser FinalApp: green, no regressions (~7 min). Live REST verification against a freshly booted instance with a fresh admin/JWT: blank quantidade correctly defaults to 1, a duplicate-product add is cleanly rejected (JAVA_SOURCE_CAPABILITY_FAILED, zero phantom rows persisted), and totalField/inputFields are correctly exposed via panel metadata. NPDevContract:dsl module: 8/8 tests green including 4 new totalField tests; coverage ratchet re-checked twice clean (--no-build-cache) at a stable 85.1404%, floor re-pinned. Ran run-all-gates.ps1 in full: all 4 gates initially failed; traced each individually -- the dsl coverage drop (mine) is fixed; 2 generator-gate test failures, an NPDevCli coverage dip, WMS-15's missing guard, and a stale SqlDialect allowlist entry are all confirmed pre-existing/unrelated via git -S search and isolated reruns, left untouched.
